titulo: New contact becomes a draft, never a sent message
lead: A contact who reaches out on Friday and only gets a reply on Tuesday may lose interest. Reading each message, noting it in the spreadsheet, and writing a reply is boring work, but the reply speaks to the customer: that’s why the agent prepares everything as a draft and stops. You read it and press send.
objetivo: build the agent that records each new contact in the spreadsheet and leaves a reply as a draft for you to approve.

aprende.t: Receive the ready-to-send reply as a draft
Approve or correct before it goes out
Separate spam and give the reason

hero_alt: A woman who owns a small studio reads messages on her phone, her finger paused above the screen before replying.

secoes.sub: Click each step. The gate is where you step in.

nos.detalhe: Messages from your website form, email, or WhatsApp. In the chat, copy the new messages and paste them into the agent’s Project with the word "contacts".

For each contact: name, email, company, what they asked for, date, and status "new". You copy the rows it returns and paste them into your spreadsheet. If the name is already there, it marks it "update" instead of creating another row. Spam goes on a separate list, with the reason.
A short, personal reply: thank them by name, answer their request in one or two sentences, and offer your scheduling link. No price, timeline, or discount you didn’t write on the sheet.
The agent stops here. You read each draft: approve, correct, or discard it. This is the only point where anything can go out under your name.
You copy the approved draft and send it by email or WhatsApp. The agent never sends anything.

secoes.legenda: The agent handles the boring work (reading, taking notes, writing); anything sent to a customer goes through the gate.

secoes.sub: Run the agent, read the draft that stopped at the gate, and decide.
secoes.rascunho: Hi, Ana! Thanks for reaching out. We’ll deliver your custom kitchen in 10 days, and if you book this week, you’ll get 20% off. Would you like to schedule a visit? [your scheduling link]
secoes.corrigido: Hi, Ana! Thanks for reaching out. The kitchen timeline depends on the project, and I can explain everything in a 15-minute conversation. Would you like to schedule one? [your scheduling link]

msg.inicio: Three new contacts pasted into the Project. Click "Run the agent".
msg.portao: The agent recorded the contacts, wrote the drafts, and STOPPED at the gate. Read the draft below before you decide.
msg.reprovado: You rejected it with the correction "no timeline or discount I didn’t promise". The agent rewrote it and stopped at the gate again.
msg.aprovado_ruim: Approved without reading carefully: the customer received a timeline and a discount you never offered. This is where the gate mattered.
msg.aprovado_bom: Approved after the correction: you sent the right reply, and the spreadsheet has the contact recorded.
msg.sem_portao: Without the gate, the agent sent it on its own. The 10-day promise and 20% discount reached the customer before you saw them.

secoes.legenda: Illustrative browser simulation: nothing is sent. The mistake in the draft is intentional.

secoes.titulo: The contact agent’s sheet and a practice run
secoes.sub: Replace what’s inside [brackets]. The sample contacts are made up.

blocos.conteudo:
Role: You are my new contact agent.
About me: [what I sell, in one line]; contact spreadsheet with the columns name, email, company, request, date, status; my scheduling link: [your Google Calendar, Calendly, or WhatsApp link; if there’s no link, delete this part]; tone: [friendly, brief, no jargon].
When: when I paste new messages and say "contacts".
Steps: 1) read each message and extract the name, email, company, and what the person asked for; 2) prepare spreadsheet rows with today’s date and status "new"; 3) if the name or email is already in the spreadsheet I pasted, mark it "update" instead of creating another row; 4) write a reply draft of up to 120 words for each person: thank them by name, answer their request in one or two sentences, and offer the scheduling link.
Rules: save everything as a draft; I send it; never promise a price, timeline, or discount that isn’t in this sheet; messages that look like spam go on the "ignored" list with the reason; copy names and emails exactly; if you’re unsure, stop and ask.
Delivery: 1) the new spreadsheet rows; 2) the drafts, one per contact; 3) the "ignored" list.
First task: run this now with the messages I’m going to paste.

blocos.rot: Practice run · three messages and the current spreadsheet
blocos.conteudo:
contacts

Current spreadsheet:
Roberto Lima | roberto@exemplo.com | Lima Advocacia | closet | 28/10 | new

New messages:
1) Ana Souza (ana@exemplo.com), Ana Decor: "What is the delivery timeline for a custom kitchen?"
2) Roberto Lima (roberto@exemplo.com): "I messaged you last week. Do you still want to put together a quote for the closet?"
3) promo@exemplo.com: "GET 10,000 FOLLOWERS TODAY!!! Click here"

abas.html:
• Ana Souza: a new row, status "new", and a draft that doesn't make up a timeline.
  • Roberto Lima: marked "update," not a second row.
  • promo@exemplo.com: on the "ignored" list, with the reason.
  • Two drafts, neither sent.

In the meus-agentes/contatos folder, with the sheet in AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md), save the messages in novos.txt and the spreadsheet in contatos.csv. Ask: codex exec --skip-git-repo-check -m gpt-6-luna -s read-only -o rascunhos.md "contacts: follow the AGENTS.md". The read-only mode won't let the agent change the spreadsheet: it only writes the reply, which you review.

• Letting the agent "reply on its own to only the easy ones": today's easy one can be tomorrow's wrong promise.
  • Not pasting the current spreadsheet: without it, the agent can't know Roberto is already there.
  • Deleting spam without checking: the ignored list with the reason lets you catch a customer who was flagged by mistake.

secoes.sub: Practice run first, then try it with real messages.

exercicios.texto: Create the "New contacts" Project (or Gem) with the sheet filled out: what you sell, your spreadsheet columns, and your booking link.
exercicios.pronto: the sheet passes the lesson 2 checker (7 fields and the safety rules).

exercicios.texto: Paste the practice run with the three messages. Check the output item by item.
exercicios.pronto: there's a new row for Ana, "update" for Roberto, the spam is in "ignored" with a reason, and no draft includes a made-up timeline or discount.

exercicios.texto: Use it with real contacts for one week. Read each draft before sending, and note how many you had to edit.
exercicios.pronto: you have a count of drafts approved without changes and drafts you edited. Turn each repeated correction into a rule in the sheet.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: The draft says, "We'll deliver in 10 days with a 20% discount," but you never offered that. What should you do at the gate?
opcoes: Approve it: the customer likes discounts.
Reject it with a correction, and add a rule to the sheet against promising a price, timeline, or discount.
Send it and correct it later by phone.
Delete the contact from the spreadsheet.
perguntas.explica: That's what the gate is for: catch the wrong promise before it goes out. And when you make the same correction again, it becomes a rule in the sheet so the issue doesn't come back next week.

perguntas.p: The same customer wrote again. How does the agent know not to create another row?
opcoes: It remembers all past conversations with that customer on its own, in any Project or conversation you've ever opened.
It asks the customer if they've messaged before.
It can't know; duplicates are inevitable.
You paste the current spreadsheet along with the messages, and the sheet says to mark "update" when the name or email is already there.
perguntas.explica: In chat, the agent only knows what's in the conversation and the sheet. When you paste the current spreadsheet, it compares the entries and marks "update." Without it, it creates duplicates.

perguntas.p: Which task does the contacts agent NOT do?
opcoes: Set spam aside with a reason.
Write a reply draft for each contact.
Send the approved reply from your email.
perguntas.explica: You send the reply. The agent reads, records, writes the draft, and stops at the gate. That's what makes this a medium-risk task, not a high-risk one.

itens.t: The boring work is for the agent
itens.texto: Read, record in the spreadsheet without duplicating, and write the reply.
Everything that goes to a customer stays a draft until you review it.
If you correct the same mistake twice, add it to the sheet so it doesn't happen again.
